groups.description: Participants with chromosomal rearrangement of the 16p11.2 locus causing obesity received setmelanotide QD via SC injection for 16 weeks. All participants initiated treatment with setmelanotide (starting dose being age dependent) and the dose was escalated up to a maximum dose of 3.0 mg QD. Participants either continued setmelanotide treatment by enrolling in an extension study (RM-493-022; NCT03651765) immediately following the last dose in this study or if the extension study was not open at the current clinic site, participants continued treatment in the current study for up to 1 year, resulting in treatment duration of up to 16 months.
groups.title: 16p11.2 Cohort
